sentences.ar: ضيف إجا عند جحا وضل تلات أيام.
sentences.en: A guest came to Juha and stayed three days.
After that he did not want to leave.

sentences.ar: قال: السمك والضيف بعد تلات أيام بيريحوا.
sentences.en: He said: fish and a guest after three days start to smell.

sentences.ar: الضيف ضحك وقال: أنا مش سمك.
sentences.en: The guest laughed and said: I am not a fish.
Juha said: but I am hungry.
